dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal 'C' structures form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is defined by a nearly linear sequence of four dark blobs on the flank, aligned with the longitudinal axis of the subject.
